{{Top|leg}}
A '''protein survival wafer''' was a type of [[Ration pack/Legends|survival ration]]. They were carried by members of the [[Red Moons]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group. [[Lex Kempo]] chewed on one while observing a [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]] operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gabredor III/Legends|Gabredor III]].<ref name="Blaze of Glory">{{JournalCite|8|Blaze of Glory (short story)}}</ref>
